messages:
Priya M: Heads-up: saw a spike of short WS closes (~100ms) from multiplexed clients after the routing-rollout this morning. Clients show reconnect but console still reports session open for ~30s. Anyone digging?
Liam J: saw that too. It looks like workers are doing a \"soft-shutdown\": RST the app layer but keep TCP alive while draining. Browser clients interpret as close -> reconnect. Dashboard counts don't reflect the quick churn.
Sam T: can you paste the proxy logs around one of those session IDs? curious if we hit any per-route soft quota or drain hook.
Priya M: log snippet (sanitized):
```
edge-01 | conn_id=abc123 | ws_frame=close | code=1006 | upstream=worker-5 | drain=true
worker-5 | conn_id=abc123 | app_shutdown_initiated
edge-01 | conn_id=abc123 | tcp_alive_ms=28000 | session_mark=open
```
Liam J: That tcp_alive_ms line is the clue. Proxy keeps socket open for drain window, but emits a close frame at app layer. Clients reconnect instantly -> new session created in route table, but control plane sees open socket because tcp not closed.
Sam T: UX problem: console only shows socket-level open/closed. We surface session churn only when socket fully closes. We should add an \"app-level close\" metric and show churn rate.
Priya M: Agreed. Also billing: are we charging for both old and new sessions during the drain window? That could double-bill transiently.
telemetry-bot: Query: billing_event_count(conn=abc123) -> 0 (so far), session_open_events -> 2 within 1s.
Liam J: So billing uses token-streaming events, not socket lifecycle. But some customers saw doubled PDF generation jobs triggered by reconnects. We need guardrails.
Sam T: Actionables: 1) signal to client SDKs to ignore app-layer close if restart_in_progress header present (de-dupe reconnect within 200ms). 2) Add metrics: app_close_events, fast_reconnect_rate, and socket-vs-app mismatch rate. 3) Console tile: add \"recent fast reconnects\" with example traces per route.
Priya M: Who owns the client sdk change? We should push a small debounce logic to JS/Http client and add a header for graceful-restart during rollouts.
Liam J: I'll own the SDK debounce (2xx change). Sam, can infra add the app_close_events metric and a sampling of traces? We need one-minute resolution in the console.
Sam T: yep will add a short-term sampling at edge and a dashboard alert if fast_reconnect_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Also will add a label to rollout pages to indicate \"drain semantics: app-close vs tcp-close\".
Priya M: Also update rollout playbook: when enabling sticky-route handoff, flip on client-sdk debounce in the same canary so we don't regress users.
Liam J: Good call. Small UX note: console should clearly mark sessions with \"app-close observed\" so PMs can correlate to feature rollouts.
telemetry-bot: Deploy ticket created: infra/add-app-close-metric -> canary eu-west-1 by Sam T.
Priya M: I'll prepare a short postmortem blurb for the morning stand: cause = rollout drain semantics mismatch; mitigation = sdk debounce + metric + console tile.
Liam J: Thanks team. I'll land the SDK PR and tag it to canary. If anyone sees customer-reported double-exec, ping me immediately. :pray:
